data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2020 the syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding (carried from 31 December 2019) was $140.676m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates adverse prior-year development amounting to approximately $11.224m (8.0% of opening reserves), reflecting strengthening of reserves. The adverse movement is primarily driven by natural catastrophe activity (notably 2018 catastrophe losses including Hurricane Michael and other 2018 storms) and adverse development on quota share ceded business (notably underperformance on the AXA/XL cession), with additional impact from material large losses such as Typhoon Hagibis and specific casualty losses (e.g. the NiSource gas explosion).

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (11.224m) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross cumulative incurred by underwriting year) printed in the report (page 42). The report's financial statements are denominated in USD; the claims triangle in the PDF is labeled with 'GBP ' in one place but the numeric totals match the USD-stated gross claims outstanding on the balance sheet, so amounts are reported in USD. No explicit single-line 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross figure was presented; therefore the triangle was used (calculated source). There is no indication of RITC distortions. Exact narrative statements in the report refer to 'prior year adverse movement' in percentage points rather than providing a single gross GBP / $ amount.
